notes.title: Patch Notes 1.06
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow survivors,
We have released a new patch that will ;

+ Lower general audio volume in "Intro" and "Main Menu".
+ Fix the problem about getting Steam profile name.
+ Fix the problem where full screen state changes in main menu.
+ Some UI changes.
+ Fix some minor performance problems.

Next patch will be about story mode! We will be correcting story telling issues and make story mode more enjoyable.

Thank you and have fun!
The Last One Team

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.05
notes.notes:
Hello fellow survivors,
We have released a new patch that will :

- [b]Add option to close all music in the game. [/b]

  ( We added this feature because some players wanted to close it and there is 
  a copyright problem with the musics on Youtube. So if you are making a video 
  about The Last One, please click Close Music button in the options menu.)

- [b]Reminder the quality you are playing on.[/b] 

  ( There is a option to select graphic 
  quality when you first launch The Last One, it is automaticly comes with 
  lower graphics. If you don't change it, you will play with lower quality. We have 
  added a reminder just before main menu to remind which graphic quality you 
  are playing. If you want to change it, just click change button right under it. )

- [b]Change the style of UI at some scenes.[/b]

- [b]Remove the login part in the beginning.[/b] 

  (Your character name will be your 
  Steam community name. This will delete your market purchases and your 
  level. If you want to return to your old character please click Change 
  Character on the main menu and type your old character name.)

- [b]Lower music volume.[/b]

- [b]Correct some language translation problems.[/b]

- [b]Fix cursor remaining open after opening pause menu.[/b]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.03
notes.notes:
Hi fellow survivors,

This patch will add new details to game and improve performance.

Change list : 

- Added a blue arrow to the allies in wave mode.
- Texture improvements.
- Optimization improvements.
- Fixed the issue about boss zombies that can't hit you.
- Changed some voice recordings position in order to make them more understandable.
- Fixed some level design bugs.
- Fixed laser sword light problem.

Thank you and have fun !

The Last One Team

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.02
notes.notes:
Hi fellow survivors,

This patch will solve all known issues in the game. Thank you for your patience and have fun.

Change list :

- Options menu is now fully operatible. Added advanced settings and mouse sensitivity.
- Game will no longer crash.
- Shadows will no longer disappear and appear again.
- Changed all zombie sounds. They are now more scary and realistic.
- Changed the story part where you needed  to climb a ladder. Instead player will get across with a little bridge.
- Dead soldiers will drop weapons when killed. You can pick them up for some extra ammo.
- Pistol reload animation will no longer play twice when reloading.
- Changed holosight's aim area.

Please report any bug you found through our forum. 

Thanks and best wishes to all,
The Last One Team

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.01
notes.notes:
Greetings Survivors,

Our first patch have arrived. Thank you for your patience. This patch will correct errors, bugs and technical problems and improve the performance.. There will be another patch in 1-2 weeks which will add new features and content to the game. ( There is a game exhibition this week and this weekend so we will try to bring the next patch ASAP. )

List of the changes : 

- Zombies will not appear from behind often. It is now balanced. They will spawn somewhere else.
- Shadows will no longer flick or shake.
- When playing in Fastest game quality, some game models was white empty models. This has been corrected.
- When playing in Fastest game quality, some textures turns to lower quality. This has been corrected.
- There was some Turkish in Options menu even if you playing with another language. This has been corrected.
- The problem about seeing the blank world through some spots is corrected.
- In story mode some enemies was going through walls. This has been corrected.
- Player was running so fast and walking so slow. Now it will run slower and walk faster.
- Ladder was a little difficult to climb. Now climbing it will be easier.
- When in Taksim Square there was 8 waves of zombies. Now it will be 4 waves.
- Removed the second boss in the KeyPad area.
-Changed the map design a little bit. With this change, players will find the objective easier.
- Multiplayer is now functioning. Removed the map that is closing the game when starting a room. It will be added back with the next update.
- C4 is now glowing in green. This will help players locate it easier.
- Game should run smoothier because of some optimization work.


This is it for now. As i said, this patch is for the problems in the game. Next patch will be about adding new content like new weapons, skills, maps and more. 
If you found any bug or have any problem with the game please write below or post on the community forum. I will reply to you as soon as possible.

Thank you for your patience, have fun !

Ataberk Ateş

We are proud to announce our release date ! The Last One will release in January 22.

notes.title: About Release Date
notes.notes:
Hi fellow survivors,

We have won the " Best Turkish Indie Game of 2017" award with your help !
We are thankfull to everybody who have involved in voting !

Unfortunatelly we need to postpone our release date a little further.
We will use this time to fix more bugs and make the game more enjoyable for the players.

We want to give the best experience we can give in launch !
Sorry to take Istanbul a little further from you but you will not regret it, we promise !


See you all in Istanbul !

Ataberk Ateş
Phoenix Interactive
